title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Technical Customer Service Administrator

Location: East Anglia

Salary: Competitive Salary + Excellent Benefits

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an organised and detail-oriented Technical Customer Service Administrator to join a successful engineering and manufacturing business.

This is a varied and fast-paced role supporting the processing of technical enquiries, quotations and customer orders. Working closely with engineering, commercial and project teams, you'll play a key role in ensuring customer requirements are accurately interpreted, recorded and progressed through the business.

This is not a traditional customer service position. The role is ideally suited to someone who enjoys working with technical information, engineering documentation and business systems while providing a high standard of customer support.

The Role

As a Technical Customer Service Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
- Managing customer enquiries and purchase orders from receipt through to processing.
- Reviewing technical specifications, drawings and supporting documentation to ensure information is complete and accurate.
- Processing enquiries, quotations and customer orders using ERP and CRM systems.
- Maintaining accurate customer, quotation and order records.
- Supporting the smooth progression of enquiries throughout the business.
- Liaising with internal engineering, estimating, contracts and commercial teams.
- Responding to customer queries and providing updates on order progress.
- Identifying missing or incomplete information and resolving documentation queries.
- Supporting document control and maintaining accurate technical records.
- Ensuring all work is completed in line with company procedures and quality standards.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining administration, technical information and customer communication within an engineering environment.

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, methodical and enjoys working with accuracy and attention to detail.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within an engineering, manufacturing or technical office environment.
- Experience in customer service, sales support, order processing or technical administration.
- Experience working with ERP and CRM systems.
- Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications or technical documentation.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication skills with a professional and customer-focused approach.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.

Knowledge of engineering products or manufacturing processes would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary.
- Company pension.
- Hybrid working
- Ongoing training and development.
- Stable and supportive working environment.
- Long-term career opportunities.
- Modern office environment.
- Opportunity to work alongside experienced engineering professionals.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join an established engineering business where accuracy, teamwork and customer service are highly valued.

You'll become an important part of a collaborative team, working closely with engineering and commercial colleagues to ensure customers receive an efficient and professional service while developing valuable technical knowledge along the way.

If you're looking for a technical administration role within an engineering environment where you can build a long-term career, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential discussion.

title: Site Coordinator
description:
ONSITE COORDINATOR - NORFOLK

Location: Watton, IP25 6 LW
Shift Pattern: 4 on / 4 off - 5:30am to 5:30pm
Salary: 29,400 - 32,760
Annual Leave: 20 days

Prestige Recruitment Specialists are looking for an Onsite Coordinator to join our team in Norfolk and play a key role in managing and supporting a busy workforce within a food manufacturing environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is organised, proactive and enjoys working with people. Previous recruitment experience is not essential as full training and ongoing support will be provided.

THE ROLE

As an Onsite Coordinator, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of the temporary workforce, working closely with both our candidates and client to ensure staffing requirements are consistently met.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing the existing workforce, including booking staff and managing attendance.
- Registering and onboarding new candidates.
- Introducing new starters to the workplace and ensuring they understand site requirements.
- Delivering inductions to new starters.
- Completing payroll administration and daily/weekly reporting.
- Recruiting new workers to support the ongoing growth of the workforce.
- Maintaining strong communication with both candidates and the client.
- Working closely with the wider internal team to ensure staffing levels and requirements are met.
- Providing support and cover for other members of the team when required.

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for someone who is confident, organised and enjoys working in a fast-paced environment.

You will ideally have:
- Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
- Good communication skills in both English and Romanian.
- The ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
- A reliable and proactive approach to work.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- Confidence communicating with both candidates and clients.
- A willingness to work in both an office environment and regularly on the food factory shop floor.

Previous experience in recruitment, administration, workforce management or a similar role would be advantageous, but it is not essential.

FLEXIBILITY

Due to the nature of the role, you will be required to provide additional cover for other members of the team when necessary. This will be approximately 20 additional working days per year outside of your normal 4-on-4-off shift pattern.

WHAT WE OFFER
- Competitive salary.
- Salary review following successful completion of probation.
- Full training and ongoing support.
- Opportunities for career progression and development.
- 20 days annual leave.
- Life insurance.
- Regular company events and socials.
- A friendly, supportive and family-feel working environment.
- The opportunity to play a key role in shaping and promoting an established, award-winning recruitment business.

title: Student Administration Assistant
description:
Student Administration Assistant

9 month FTC

Norwich City Centre

This role plays a key part in supporting students as they begin their apprenticeship journey, helping to create a positive and professional experience from day one. Why This Role?

You'll be at the heart of the student experience, greeting learners, supporting exam administration, helping with apprenticeship onboarding and ensuring students receive a warm and professional welcome.

Some days you may be supporting just a handful of students, while on others you could be welcoming over 100 people through the doors. It's a varied role that would suit someone who enjoys working with people, building relationships and keeping organised in a fast-paced environment.

You'll be joining a friendly, collaborative team where support is always available, making it a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys customer-facing work and wants to gain experience within education and training.

What You'll Be Doing

Student Support & Customer Service
- Acting as a first point of contact for students attending the centre
- Providing a professional and welcoming experience for all visitors
- Responding to student enquiries via email and occasional telephone calls

Exam & Apprenticeship Administration
- Assisting with the scheduling and coordination of examinations
- Invigilating exams and ensuring procedures are followed
- Helping enrol students onto apprenticeship programmes

Operations & Administration
- Maintaining accurate records and updating internal systems
- Supporting the production of student progress reports
- Managing general administrative tasks and document processing

What We're Looking For
- Previous administration or customer service experience
- Strong face-to-face communication skills
- Confidence interacting with large groups of people
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Comfortable using IT systems and Microsoft Office

Nice to Have
- Experience within education, training or apprenticeships
- Previous exam invigilation or administration experience
- Experience working in a busy customer facing environment

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
We're recruiting on behalf of our client, for an organised and personable Recruitment Administrator to join their busy recruitment team on a temporary basis. In this role, you'll provide essential administrative support across the recruitment process, helping to ensure a smooth and positive experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.

If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a keen eye for detail and enjoys supporting people through every stage of the recruitment journey, this could be the role for you. Hybrid working may be considered for up to two days a week once trained and undertaking certain duties.

What you'll be doing:
- Drafting job adverts for review
- Arranging interviews with candidates and hiring managers
- Preparing conditional offer letters and completing pre-employment recruitment checks
- Arranging start dates for new starters
- Responding to general enquiries via telephone, email and face to face
- Supporting at in-person recruitment events
- Data entry and retrieval for vacancies, applicants and colleagues using the Electronic Staff Records (ESR) system

What we're looking for:
- Previous recruitment and customer service experience
- Experience using applicant tracking systems or staff record systems
- Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling candidate and employee information
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel)
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Confident communication skills and a professional, approachable manner
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a busy recruitment team where your organisational skills and people-focused approach will make a real difference to the candidate experience. Perfect for someone available immediately and looking to build on their recruitment administration experience.

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

PLEASE NOTE: We can only consider applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.
